rules.swings: closing prices: a close below (above) the closes of the 5 bars before and 3 after; known 3 bars later
rules.divergence: each new swing vs every earlier same-side swing 5-60 bars back; the earliest valid one per type; RSI at the swing candles
rules.equal_swings: closes less than 0.25 ATR apart are an equal high/low: not a divergence, not recorded
rules.clean_lines: no close and no RSI value between the swings crosses either connecting line
rules.regular_rsi_zone: bullish: a swing RSI <= 40; bearish: a swing RSI >= 60
rules.regular_prior_trend: at swing 1: bullish close < EMA50 and EMA50 below its value 10 bars earlier; bearish mirrored
rules.major_levels: 4h swing closes (highs and lows) of the stored history, clustered within 0.5 x 4h ATR; >= 2 swings = a level
rules.regular_filter: swing 2 close within 0.5 x 4h ATR of a major level whose swings were all known before swing 1 formed
rules.hidden_filter: trend: close beyond EMA50 and EMA50 sloping that way over 10 bars, at availability
rules.confirmation: first lower-timeframe close beyond the latest opposing lower-timeframe swing close (2/2), frozen at availability
rules.volume_confirmation: lower-timeframe volume of candles closing in the trade direction >= volume of candles closing against it, from the close of the swing-2 candle to the break (inclusive)
rules.no_chase: skip if entry > 2 ATR from swing 2, or a confirmed opposite swing of the last 60 bars lies between entry and the 2R target
rules.lower_tf_trend: warning only: the break candle closes above (long) / below (short) the lower-timeframe EMA50
rules.opposing_divergence: warning only: no long while the latest minor swing high (60 bars) has a higher close but lower RSI (>= 60) than an earlier one and no close has broken it; mirrored for shorts
rules.level_in_the_way: warning only: a major 4h level band (its own level excluded) between the entry and the 2R target
rules.htf_trend_hidden: hidden divergences: next timeframe up (4h for 1h, 1d for 4h) close beyond its EMA50 and EMA50 sloping that way over 10 bars
rules.stop: 0.1 ATR beyond the previous swing extreme (wick): regular = lowest low / highest high from swing 1 to swing 2; hidden = swing 2's own swing low / high
rules.entry: next available contiguous 15m open after trigger close; no same-bar fill
rules.gap_policy: reset indicators/pivots across gaps; invalidate pending setups
rules.news: context only; does not change frozen execution rules

notes: DIV-SR-2: swing-structure pivots (5 left / 3 right), RSI matched within 2 bars, clean price and RSI lines, four divergence types each backtested as its own book; regular types need support/resistance, hidden types need the EMA50 trend, every entry needs a volume-confirmed lower-timeframe structure break.
Preliminary fixed-rule study on a current ten-symbol liquid universe; selection/survivorship bias remains. No claim of profitability or qualification.
Each symbol/timeframe is an independent $1,000 paper book. Returns are not a combined portfolio.
Chronological 70/30 development/holdout split with a 15-minute boundary embargo; rules were not tuned on either subset. Warm-up precedes eligible entries.
Historical replay contains only the mechanical rule. AI debate/news filtering begins prospectively; historical news and invented agent votes are excluded.
Taker fees 0.04% and adverse slippage 0.02% per side plus actual Binance funding. Stops win candles touching both stop and target.
Forward entries use fresh observed quotes after confirmation/review. Historical fills use the next 15-minute open; execution latency differs.

Forward partial entry-minute stop touches are conservatively counted as losses; partial-minute targets require an observed quote. Funding with ambiguous intrabar exit ordering charges debits and withholds credits.
